name: Payment
description: Review account status, the current invoice, next payment date, billing cycle, available payment methods, and payment history.

tasks.title: Review the current invoice
tasks.summary: Check the account status and current invoice before making a payment.
steps: Check Next Payment Date and Billing Cycle.

tasks.title: Pay by ACH bank payment
tasks.summary: Use Pay With Bank when ACH is available for the company account.

tasks.title: Review manual payment information
tasks.summary: Use the Manual Payment section when the tenant provides a manual payment method.

tasks.title: Review payment history
tasks.summary: Use Payment History to review previous billing transactions.
steps: Review previous payment records and dates.
